title: Review: feat(backend): SQLite BLOB block store backend
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — schema verification gap and missing version tracking are real but low-probability in practice (operators using SQLite are unlikely to point it at a wrong file). The IPNS log message is noisy but cosmetic.
Confidence: 85% chance no missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: schema compatibility on upgrade (the P0 bug), and the undocumented behavior of SQLite in-memory pools with max_connections > 1. Would raise confidence if: schema validation probe was added to open() and a test confirmed startup failure on incompatible schema.
